fields.name: user_type
fields.label: User Type
fields.description: A Website User only ever has the Website User role, whatever roles are listed: for customers and visitors who sign in to portals, never for staff.

fields.name: role_profile
fields.label: Role Profile
fields.description: Choosing a profile replaces this user's roles with the profile's roles.

fields.name: module_profile
fields.label: Module Profile
fields.description: Hides the modules the profile blocks.

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language of the Desk for this person (a language code such as ar), set by them on any device they sign in from.

fields.name: email_two_factor
fields.label: Email sign-in code
fields.description: Set by the person on their Account page: signing in also needs a code sent to their email.
